unit: one LibriSpeech utterance, identified by utterance_id
annotator_requirement: A person applies the guidelines after reading the reference text and listening to the FLAC. An unannotated row uses not_annotated and does not invent labels.

json_fields.entities_explicitly_mentioned: A JSON list of strings copied from the reference, or the token not_annotated. An empty list means the annotator found no explicit entity. It is not a substitute for not_annotated.
json_fields.task_slots: A JSON list of objects with name and value, or the token not_annotated. Use an empty list only when task_intent_status is genuinely_present and no slot was stated.

task_oriented_schema_proposal.rule: Apply only to a dataset whose utterances are task requests and whose schema is fixed before annotation.
